verses.text: For the music director. A psalm for reflection by the sons of Korah. God, we’ve heard it with our own ears. Our ancestors told us what you did in their time, long ago.
With your own hand you drove out nations and planted our ancestors in their place. You struck those peoples and gave our ancestors room to spread.
They didn’t win the land by their swords or save themselves by their strength. Your right hand, your strong arm, and the light of your face won it for them, because you favored them.
You are my King, God. Give the command that brings Jacob victory!
Through you we’ll push back our enemies. In your name we’ll trample those who rise against us.
I won’t put my trust in my bow, and my sword can’t save me.
You saved us from our enemies and put those who hate us to shame.
All day long we’ve boasted in God. We’ll thank your name forever. Selah.
But now you’ve rejected us and brought us to shame. You no longer go out with our armies.
You make us turn and run from the enemy. Those who hate us take whatever they want.
You’ve handed us over like sheep for food and scattered us among the nations.
You sold your people for nothing. You gained nothing from the sale.
You’ve made us a disgrace to our neighbors. Everyone around us mocks and ridicules us.
You’ve made us a joke among the nations. People shake their heads at us.
My disgrace is in front of me all day long, and shame covers my face,
because of the insults of those who mock and abuse me, because of the enemy who wants revenge.
All this has happened to us, yet we haven’t forgotten you or broken faith with your covenant.
Our hearts haven’t turned away, and our feet haven’t strayed from your path,
even though you’ve crushed us in a place where jackals live and covered us with the shadow of death.
If we had forgotten our God’s name or stretched out our hands to another god,
wouldn’t God find out? He knows the secrets of the heart.
For your sake we face death all day long. People treat us like sheep ready for slaughter.
Wake up, Lord! Why are you sleeping? Rise up! Don’t reject us forever.
Why do you hide your face and forget our suffering and oppression?
We’ve sunk down into the dust. Our bodies cling to the ground.
Rise up to help us. Rescue us because of your faithful love.
